## Install (fresh)

1. Download `{zip-name}` from this release.
2. Extract it anywhere except `Program Files`.
3. Run `VRCFaceTracking.exe`. Install your tracking module from the Module Registry tab if you have not before.
4. Launch VRChat with OSC enabled. The Home tab shows the module as active once it is receiving data.

Settings and installed modules live in `%AppData%\VRCFaceTracking` and are shared with the Steam build, so an existing setup carries over.
